recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No FHIR core follow-up is needed; any future changes to this guidance should be made in HL7/fhir-testing-ig rather than restoring duplicate TestScript prose in core.
issue_request: FHIR-12582 was a Published/Persuasive with Modification DSTU2 FHIR-core TestScript issue asking for a way to conditionally execute an assert based on previous assert results within the context of a single operation. The accepted resolution was to add language to the R4 Testing FHIR page describing conditional asserts and the current workaround.
initial_application: Commit eefe2ea34770cfac3e3b14aabc549efe855a4101, "GF 12582", added the Conditional Asserts subsection to source/testing.html, explaining that native TestScript execution does not conditionally evaluate asserts, that warningOnly=true can be used as the current workaround, and that an external Rules engine may be supplied through an implementation guide.
additional_context: Current core no longer builds local TestScript/TestReport/TestPlan resources or source/testing.html. Commit f9a44787c45071394532c7c2ee94d76f30f47387 removed those testing resources from core and deleted source/testing.html while adding an active [additional-ig-list] testing mapping to https://build.fhir.org/ig/HL7/fhir-testing-ig. The delegated HL7/fhir-testing-ig source at commit 3fa8dc91c003f7cf83b281a1f553cb1d82caa15c contains the Conditional Asserts guidance in input/pagecontent/testing.xml.
reconciliation: No core source change was made. The current core source correctly delegates TestScript content to the FHIR Testing IG, and that IG contains the relevant conditional-assert workaround guidance.
